notes.title: Player Walk Speed Increased
notes.content: [list][*][p]I've slightly increased the player's walking speed based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for sharing your thoughts! I’ll continue striving to make this game the best it can be, and every lesson learned here will help shape my future projects![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Chapter 2 Balancing
notes.content: [p][b]Update Notes – Chapter 2 Balancing[/b][/p][list][*][p]The enemy in Chapter 2 now has only a [b]25% chance to blow out lit candles[/b], rather than extinguishing them immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]The player's lighter now features an [b]increased attenuation radius[/b], offering better visibility in darker areas.[/p][/*][/list][p]I want to sincerely thank everyone for the feedback on [b]Chapter 2[/b]. I understand it may have felt overly difficult for some, and I’m still learning how to strike the right balance between challenge and enjoyment. While some players found creative ways to push through, others struggled, so I truly hope this update brings a more fair and fun experience for everyone.[/p][p]Your support means the world to me, and these lessons will absolutely help shape my future projects.[/p][p][b]Thank you again for playing![/b][/p]

notes.title: 4K Support + Cursor Fix
notes.content: [p][b]- Added full 4K resolution support.[/b][/p][p][b]- Fixed an issue where players were unable to Alt+Tab out of the game.[/b][/p][p][b]- Resolved a bug causing the mouse cursor to drift in menus or become stuck in the corner of the screen.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content: [p][/p][list][*][p]Increased the frequency of lightning strikes in Chapter 2 to improve visibility during stealth sequences.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked AI audio cues in Chapter 2 to make it easier to gauge enemy positioning.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Hope these changes enhance your experience—and as always, thank you for the continued support![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Certain key items will now emit a subtle glow by default, making them easier to spot without needing to be directly observed first.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where the mouse cursor could drift while navigating menus. While I was unable to reproduce this during extensive playtesting, this update includes a [b]potential fix[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p] Thank you for all the support![/p]

[b]Claire – Release Date Trailer Launches May 17th[/b]
